thread:
jo: Quick broadcast: dry-run of a planned customer-facing SLO window adjustment + failover drill for na-east on Mon 08/01 02:00-02:30 UTC. This is a validation dry-run only (no actual traffic cut) to exercise comms, monitoring, and rollback flows. Please ack if you want to opt out. :loud_sound:

felix: Ack. Dry-run means no real traffic change, right? Just simulate alerts and runbook steps?

jo: Correct. We'll simulate the SLO annotation, trigger synthetic canaries, and run the failover-playbook but stop before executing any routing changes. The goal is to validate runbook clarity and alerting behavior.

anya: I'll flip the monitoring annotation and synthetic canary. Plan: 2-minute canary at 02:05 with synthetic-traffic=1% baseline.

oncall-sre: I'll be oncall and will step through the runbook. If anything looks like a real customer impact, I'll halt and notify.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "NA-EAST SLO-window dry-run" Mon 08/01 02:00-02:30 UTC. Attendees: eng-sre, eng-platform, obs.

felix: Runbook link? I want to ensure rollback steps are stubbed out for the dry-run.

jo: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eng-sre/slo-window-failover. Note: dry-run flag set for this execution; commands will print actions rather than execute. Example: `redwood-failover plan --region na-east --dry-run=true`

deploy-bot: Preflight job scheduled at 01:45 UTC: preflight-198765-dry1. Includes metric snapshot, KV check, and alerts smoke test.

anya: Preflight complete: metrics snapshot OK, KV lag < 20ms, alerting smoke test triggered expected internal P0 -> cleared. Ready for dry-run.

oncall-sre: Running through playbook now. Step 1: annotate SLO window (dry). Step 2: trigger synthetic canary. Step 3: simulate failover plan (no route changes).

felix: Observed synthetic canary behavior: p95 +10ms in sim, no errors. Internal alerting fired in the expected channel but pager suppression honored.

jo: Great. Please verify customer-facing channels did not receive alerts and SLA docs unaffected.

oncall-sre: Confirmed. No customer alerts sent. Internal SLO burn tags applied and removed successfully. All rollback stubs tested.

anya: Post-run checklist: update runbook with a clearer dry-run checklist, add a step to test PSC (pager-suppression-config) before live window.

felix: I'll file the small follow-ups and assign owners. Thanks team. Dry-run considered successful. :white_check_mark:
